newsitem.title: USA: Northwest files for $274.5 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Northwest files for $274.5 mln shelf offer.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp filed Wednesday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $274.5 million in convertible debt securities, preferred stock, class A common stock and warrants to buy class A stock.
When combined with $225.5 million of those securities left under a previous registration, the company will have up to $500 million of those securities available for sale, Northwest said.
Net proceeds will be added to the company's working capital and available for general corporate purposes, including repayment of debt and financing of capital expenditures, Northwest said.
No underwriters were listed in the filing.
